app.name: Google Drive — online backup
app.description: Google Drive lets you securely store, organise and collaborate on files and folders from anywhere, on any device. Part of Google Workspace with 15GB of free storage.

verdict.one_liner: Google scans your files for abuse but promises not to use them for ads.
verdict.summary: Google Drive stores your files on Google's servers. Google uses automated systems to analyze uploaded content to detect abuse such as spam, malware, and illegal content. Google explicitly states it does not show personalized ads based on Drive content. Your data may be shared with affiliates, partners, and disclosed for legal reasons. Domain administrators may access Workspace accounts.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Google scans your uploaded files with automated systems and may share your data with third parties or for legal requests. However, Google explicitly promises not to use your Drive content for ads.

red.title: Google uses automated systems to analyze your content
red.plain_english: Google uses automated systems to analyze the files you upload to Drive to detect abuse such as spam, malware, and illegal content. The policy does not clearly explain whether humans also review your files.

red.title: Work or school admin may access your account
red.plain_english: If you use a Google Workspace account through your employer or school, your domain administrator may be able to access and retain information stored in your account, including your email and files.

red.title: Data may be shared for legal reasons
red.plain_english: Google may share your personal information in response to legal process, regulation, or enforceable government requests. Google publishes a Transparency Report about these requests.

green.title: Drive content is not used for ads
green.plain_english: Google explicitly states that it does not show personalized ads based on the content you store in Drive, Gmail, or Photos.

green.title: Encryption in transit
green.plain_english: Google uses encryption to keep your data private while it is being sent to and from Google's servers.

green.title: You can delete your content
green.plain_english: You can delete the content you upload to Drive whenever you like, such as photos and documents.

green.title: You can export your data
green.plain_english: Google allows you to export a copy of your content for backup or use with a service outside of Google.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention Google Drive accessing your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: The general Google Privacy Policy is silent on whether Google Drive specifically uses camera or microphone access. Voice and audio information is discussed in the context of other Google services.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Google may collect your location when you use Google Drive, including from your IP address, but the policy does not clearly explain why Drive needs this.
categories.detail: The general Google Privacy Policy states location information is collected when you use Google services. This includes IP address and other location signals. It does not specify Drive's use of location data.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect location information when you use our services, which helps us offer features like driving directions, search results for things near you, and ads based on your location.
concerns: General location collection applies to all services including Drive

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Google may use your contacts to help you share Drive files, but the policy does not clearly explain how much contact data is accessed.
categories.detail: The general policy mentions suggesting recipients from contacts when sharing content. It does not specify the extent of contact access for Drive specifically.
categories.policy_excerpt: We use your information to deliver our services, like processing the terms you search for in order to return results or helping you share content by suggesting recipients from your contacts.
concerns: Contact access implied for sharing but not explicitly detailed for Drive

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Google Drive collects the files you upload, including documents, photos, and videos, and stores them on Google's servers.
categories.detail: The general Google Privacy Policy explicitly mentions collecting content you create, upload, or receive, including docs, spreadsheets, photos, and videos. These are stored on Google's servers and may be analyzed by automated systems.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also collect the content you create, upload, or receive from others when using our services. This includes things like email you write and receive, photos and videos you save, docs and spreadsheets you create.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Google may share your information with affiliates, advertisers, and partners, and may disclose it to domain administrators or for legal reasons.
categories.detail: The general policy lists several cases for sharing personal information outside Google: with consent, with domain administrators, for external processing with affiliates and service providers, and for legal reasons. Non-personally identifiable information may also be shared with partners.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not share your personal information with companies, organizations, or individuals outside of Google except in the following cases: With your consent; With domain administrators; For external processing; For legal reasons.
concerns: Data shared with affiliates and service providers
Non-personally identifiable information shared with advertisers and partners

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You need a Google Account to use Google Drive, and Google collects your name, email, and may collect payment information.
categories.detail: The general policy states that creating a Google Account requires providing personal information including name and password. Phone number and payment information may optionally be added.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create a Google Account, you provide us with personal information that includes your name and a password. You can also choose to add a phone number or payment information to your account.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Google states it does not use your Drive content to show ads, but your activity across other Google services may still be used for personalized advertising.
categories.detail: The general Google Privacy Policy explicitly states: 'We don't show you personalized ads based on your content from Drive, Gmail, or Photos.' However, it also states that personalized ads may be shown based on interests and activity across Google services.
categories.policy_excerpt: We don't show you personalized ads based on your content from Drive, Gmail, or Photos. Depending on your settings, we may also show you personalized ads based on your interests and activity across Google services.
concerns: Activity across other Google services tracked for ads

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Google offers Family Link accounts for children under 13.
categories.detail: The general Google Privacy Policy references Google Accounts Managed with Family Link for children under 13 or applicable age.
categories.policy_excerpt: Google Accounts Managed with Family Link, for Children under 13 (or applicable age in your country)

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Google collects your IP address, crash reports, and system activity when you use Drive, and may use your IP address to estimate your location for ads.
categories.detail: The general policy explicitly lists IP address, crash reports, system activity, date/time, and referrer URL as collected interaction data. IP address may be used to estimate location for ads.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also collect information about the interaction of your apps, browsers, and devices with our services, including IP address, crash reports, system activity, and the date, time, and referrer URL of your request.
concerns: IP used for location inference and ads

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Google collects unique device identifiers and other device details, which may be used for personalized advertising.
categories.detail: The general policy lists unique identifiers, browser type, device type, OS, mobile network info, carrier name, phone number, and application version. It states that depending on settings, personalized ads may be shown based on interests and activity across Google services.
categories.policy_excerpt: The information we collect includes unique identifiers, browser type and settings, device type and settings, operating system, mobile network information including carrier name and phone number, and application version number.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention Google Drive collecting health or biometric data.
categories.detail: The general Google Privacy Policy does not address health or biometric data collection for Google Drive.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Google collects payment information if you add it to your account, for example to upgrade Drive storage.
categories.detail: The general policy states payment methods added to your Google Account can be used across services. This would apply to Drive storage upgrades via Google One or Workspace.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create a Google Account, you provide us with personal information that includes your name and a password. You can also choose to add a phone number or payment information to your account.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete your uploaded content, but Google may retain some data for legal or security reasons.
categories.detail: The general policy states some data can be deleted whenever you like, while other data is retained for longer periods for legitimate business or legal purposes. There may be delays across backup systems.
categories.policy_excerpt: Some data you can delete whenever you like, such as your personal info or the content you create or upload, like photos and documents. And some data we retain for longer periods of time when necessary for legitimate business or legal purposes.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Google states it will not reduce your rights under the privacy policy without your explicit consent, and it will provide more prominent notice for significant changes.
categories.detail: Google explicitly commits to not reducing rights without explicit consent. It indicates the date of last changes, offers archived versions, and provides more prominent notice (including email notification for certain services) for significant changes.
categories.policy_excerpt: We change this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without your explicit consent. We always indicate the date the last changes were published and we offer access to archived versions for your review. If changes are significant, we'll provide a more prominent notice (including, for certain services, email notification of Privacy Policy changes).
